notes.title: The Crazy Golf DLC is Out Now!
notes.notes: [h1]Announcing the Crazy Golf World DLC[/h1][p]This Crazy Golf-themed world unlocks 18 additional levels for Coloring Voxels. Create an entire 18-hole golf course with all the crazy turns and obstacles you know and love![/p][p align="start"][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45637097/bd25e1e656274e76069f0667d81e56d29cafe7b1.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][p align="start"]A one-off special that includes 18 levels instead of 16 to match the golfing theme![/p][p align="start"]Grab your clubs and get ready to hit a hole-in-one.[/p][p][/p][p]Available for $1.99, £1.69 (or your regional equivalent).[/p][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/4008230"][/dynamiclink][/p][h2]Upcoming Game Changes[/h2][p]Thank you all for your support and feedback! We have been dealing with work capacity challenges and staff vacations over the past couple of weeks, which is why there are no significant updates alongside this DLC launch, but do not be concerned that we are neglecting your feedback; we have a list of tasks for us to fix and add to Coloring Voxels to make your play even more enjoyable.[/p][p][/p][p]In no particular order, here are some of the things we are working on:[/p][olist][*][p]Performance improvements and/or overhaul for the Underwater World.[/p][/*][*][p]"Difficulty" pop-up for when you first launch the game to help those who find the game too easy and don't want to have to check settings each update.[/p][/*][*][p]More camera controls and settings.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixes to the hotbar scrolling and 3-digit number selection.[/p][/*][*][p]Hint options to add more hints or turn them all off.[/p][/*][*][p]Controls page (eventually, possibly, key rebinding).[/p][/*][*][p]Easier Main Menu navigation.[/p][/*][*][p]Dark Mode.[/p][/*][*][p]Unlocked completed voxels to make the game harder.[/p][/*][*][p]Extra Play modes and commendations.[/p][/*][/olist][p][/p][p]This list isn't extensive, but it does cover a lot of the highly requested features and fixes - we are committing to addressing all of the feedback we've received and aim to get these into the game as quickly and efficiently as we can. Thank you for your understanding and patience. [/p][p][/p][p][/p][h2]Competition Reminder[/h2][p]A reminder that we have our voxel art competition live for you to get your voxel art into Coloring Voxels! Full details can be found here: [dynamiclink href="https://steamcommunity.com/games/3634590/announcements/detail/501706891564417241"][/dynamiclink][/p]

notes.title: Patch Notes
notes.notes: [h1]Even more bug fixes![/h1][p]Continuing with taking your feedback on board, Rob is back from his vacation and has fixed a long list of issues! A special thank you to everyone for your feedback and bug reports, and an even bigger shout-out to our amazing community for helping with translations! We have re-imported the entire translation document with your corrections - thank you. <3 [/p][p][/p][h1]Coloring Voxels [b]V1.5.1 Patch Notes[/b] [/h1][h2][b][u]Bug Fixes and Misc[/u][/b] [/h2][list][*][p]Achievements have now been localised into all languages supported by the game.[/p][/*][*][p]Updated Credits to include new Patreon supporters.[/p][/*][*][p]In the main menu, you can now scroll up to the height of the world when you haven't completed any levels.[/p][/*][*][p]Adjusted the properties of the water in the underwater world to be less reflective.[/p][/*][*][p]Changed the Eraser tooltip from "Remove Voxels" to "Eraser".[/p][/*][*][p]The main menu view/hide button that appears on completed levels now changes to a closed eye Icon when in its hidden state. This should make it easier to understand what the button is currently doing on worlds where it is hard to see the color change, like Medieval and Arcade.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where the view/hide button would allow you to see into neighbouring levels.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed several issues with materials that should cause voxels to change shape but weren't.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixes to the main menu world viewer to make rendering materials with some movement to create gaps in the world. This fix also addresses the issues where you could see through the rails in the City world.[/p][/*][*][p]Small adjustment to the water in the Medieval world so that it wouldn't glow in the dark.[/p][/*][*][p]More localisation changes from the community localisation spreadsheet. We made sure to pay particular attention to French after some were missed in the last update.[/p][/*][*][p]Added transparency to the smoke particle effect found in the Medieval Blacksmith level so that you can see the voxels to colour in from above a little better.[/p][/*][*][p]The tops of the flowers in the Medieval Path level now have the correct materials set.[/p][/*][*][p]The Cauldron's water in the Dungeon world now has the correct colours set.[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: V1.3 Patch Notes
notes.notes: [h1]Another big step![/h1][p]In this update, we wanted to focus on some fairly large under-the-hood changes to tackle some of the more highly requested changes people have been asking for. [/p][olist][*][p]Firstly, we have some fairly large performance gains with this patch; we still can do better and intend to, but hopefully this patch will help considerably. [/p][/*][*][p]Secondly, we wanted to add the highly requested Color Lock setting that players of Coloring Pixels love. This was a nightmare to implement which is why didn’t launch with it. Long story short but this game isn’t as simple as applying a colour to a square like its predecessor, we have much more complicated shaders and materials to consider. The result though is very satisfying and I think a couple of us in the office will be playing with this setting when playing. We highly recommend you have a go with this setting disabled to see what it feels like![/p][/*][/olist][p]I have to give a huge thank you to all of you are supporting us during this launch week. For just 7 days after launch, the game looks and feels completely different than it did a week ago. Thank you all for the feedback and keep it coming <3[/p][p][/p][h1]Coloring Voxels v1.3.3 Patch Notes[/h1][h2][u][b]New Features[/b][/u][/h2][list][*][p]New setting "[b]Color Lock[/b]" (default on) - A popular request from the Coloring Pixels players. When disabled, you can make mistakes! The colour you have selected will colour in any cube, regardless of whether it is in the correct position or not.[/p][/*][*][p][b]The main menu now supports more than 7 worlds.[/b][/p][/*][/list][h2][b][u]Bug Fixes and Misc[/u][/b] [/h2][list][*][p]Fixed dozens of issues with materials, including: [/p][list][*][p]Fixed an issue where the animals in the volcano world had red eyes.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where many City materials we set to yellow.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed several colours in the Arcade Dance machine level.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed some materials in the Planitarium Space Elevator level.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Fixed a graphical bug where materials that have movement or are larger than normal were set to normal scale.[/p][/*][*][p]The scrolling script for the layer select, color palette, and the new additions to the main menu has undergone a complete rewrite. The result should behave much more reliably and not jump around when changing between colours and layers.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue with the Arch level in the Underwater world, which caused it to be unplayable.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a behind-the-scenes bug that allowed people to load up older versions of levels that have changed. This has been most noticeable in underwater levels, which would sometimes give people levels without water or have the water black. As we originally intended, people who have save files in these older versions of levels will be able to load back into the older version, but if you new game plus or delete your save, the next time you load in, it will be with the most up-to-date version. We were hoping this feature would never really affect anyone, but it allows us to make changes to levels and for it not to affect anyone's saves.[/p][/*][*][p]Credits have been updated.[/p][/*][*][p]Major performance improvements for large levels. Standing FPS should be noticeably higher.[/p][/*][*][p]Major performance improvements when colouring in.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug where loading into a level in progress would sometimes cause the numbers to not face the correct way.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h1]The First DLC! - Computer DLC[/h1][p]As you know from some of our previous posts. Our monthly content release DLC schedule begins next week! Suggested and chosen by our Discord and Patreon members, the Computer PC will be the first of many new worlds to come! This world will feature one very large gaming PC that you can build yourself one part at a time... and yes, there will be RGB.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45637097/e8b052017a11f8e12d93bafbe6dd2802f099ab0d.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45637097/f85a91b86b3155408a441c42cebca8a86a59ca1a.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45637097/1c87de8f9aa45efcfa61d9faa8fac0128b763c6d.png"][/img][/p]

notes.title: Patch Notes
notes.notes:
[h1]Another Day, Another Patch![/h1][p]Thank you once again for your feedback! We have managed to use it to make another day of bug fixes and improvements, a special shout-out to those of you who have checked the community localisation and made edits - the changes made so far have been included in this patch, so we're one step closer to being fully localised![/p][h1]
Coloring Voxels v1.2.9 Patch Notes[/h1][h2][b][u]Bug Fixes and Misc[/u][/b] [/h2][list][*][p]Fixed a bug where auto-cycling to the next available colour was working off the "Remove Completed Layers" setting instead of the "Limit Color Palette To Layer" setting.
[/p][/*][/list][h1]Coloring Voxels v1.2.7 Patch Notes[/h1][h2][u][b]Bug Fixes and Misc[/b][/u] [/h2][list][*][p]Fixed a bug where if you had the "Remove Completed Colors From Palette" setting on and finished a colour, it wouldn't switch to the next available number.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug where switching colours was sometimes broken if you had the last colour in the palette selected.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h1]Coloring Voxels v1.2.5 Patch Notes[/h1][h2][u][b]New Features[/b][/u] [/h2][list][*][p][b]New Competition Menu Added[/b]! - Hopefully, you are aware of our voxel art competition, but if you aren't, we are continuing on our community tradition from Coloring Pixels by hosting a competition to let you have your levels in the game! This new menu, accessible from the new trophy button in the main menu, will link you to all the information you need to get started.[/p][/*][*][p]New "[b]Toggle click cancel when completing colour[/b]" setting (default to on) - Disabling this allows people who are using the "Toggle Click" setting to not have to re-click each time a colour is completed in the palette.[/p][/*][*][p]New "[b]Limit Colour Palette to Layer[/b]" setting (default on) - Allows people to have the colour palette filled with total colours for the whole level and not filtered to those that are on the currently selected layer.[/p][/*][*][p]New "[b]Remove Completed Colors From Palette[/b]" setting (default on) - Returning from Coloring pixels by popular demand, this setting allows you to stop colours being removed from the palette when complete for that much harder gameplay.[/p][p][/p][/*][/list][h2] [u][b]Bug Fixes and Misc[/b][/u] [/h2][list][*][p]Korean localisation for the Soundtrack store page is now set for Korea and not Germany.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug where pressing Shift and Q + E would only make layers shift down instead of down and up.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug where the "Toggle Click" mouse cursor asset would carry through to the main menu.[/p][/*][*][p]When you enter a level that is half complete, after the time-lapse, the camera animates to the default starting position instead of leaving you at the wrong angle.[/p][/*][*][p]Swooping formatting changes to the settings menu to make things look good for various languages.[/p][/*][*][p]Moved the game version number to the left of the settings screen instead of the middle.[/p][/*][*][p]Lots of changes to the format of the exit screen to improve things for non-English languages.[/p][/*][*][p]Settings which operate with a toggle now correctly disable themselves when not active. Notably, this happens with the "Floor Grid" and "Toggle Click" settings.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where the camera would spiral out of control if you hit an FPS lower than 1. You should never play the game like a PowerPoint presentation, but that is a problem for another day.[/p][/*][*][p]Localisation text has been updated with our community-driven spreadsheet.[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: New Features and Bug Fixes
notes.notes: [h1]Let's make this game the best it can be![/h1][p]Thank you to all of you for playing our game over the launch weekend! Your feedback has been very valuable to us, so we can make sure we can make Coloring Voxels as good as it can be for everyone![/p][p][/p][p]We have taken all of your feedback and suggestions on board and made them into tasks for our programmer Rob to work on. Below is a list of features and bug fixes we have been able to tackle already, with many more on the way.[/p][p][/p][p]More localisation fixes were addressed over the weekend, but we know there is still some work to do to make it perfect. The amazing people over on our Community Discord have been helping us with the translations, as we have a community translation document for anyone to help out with the game localisation, so if you are bilingual (or more) and would like to help out too, please feel free to check out the document [url="https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1e-c2Wehm1RhowhXUsbwf3Q5vn5nFac2LNTQUpdWWl70/edit?gid=1812160742#gid=1812160742"]here[/url] and make any fixes you can. Thank you in advance for being an amazing support![/p][p][/p][p]The following patch notes are just the beginning of the journey for Coloring Voxels. Here are some additional, large changes you have asked for that aren't implemented yet, but we are committed to adding:[/p][olist][*][p][b]Making the game harder[/b]: By adding settings you know and love from Coloring Pixels, such as "lock completed pixels" and "removing completed colours from palette", we will be able to provide a more puzzle-like feel to those of you who love this feeling in Coloring Pixels.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Game Modes[/b]: Different cameras, world settings, etc, to allow you to play vertically, colour a blank model, and more![/p][/*][*][p][b]Color Palette Options[/b]: Add a variety of options for the palette so you can see all remaining colors at once, reorder the colors per layer, etc.[/p][/*][/olist][p]And many more that we have listed on Trello, ready to work on![/p][p][/p][p]Thank you once again for playing. This is the first of many patches to the game, and it will only make your time playing even more enjoyable 💖[/p][p][/p][h1]Coloring Voxels v1.1.0 Patch Notes[/h1][h2][b][u]New Features[/u][/b] [/h2][list][*][p]New Setting "[b]New Voxel Animations[/b]" (Defaulted to On) - When disabled, the bouncing animations of voxels that you have just recently completed is skipped.[/p][/*][*][p]New Setting "[b]Hover Over Voxel Animations[/b]" (Defaulted to On) - When disabled, voxels that are not complete will no longer get larger when you hover over them.[/p][/*][*][p]New Setting "[b]Completed Voxel Animations[/b]" (Defaulted to On) - When disabled, clicking on voxels that are completed won't play the squish animation.[/p][/*][*][p]New Setting "[b]Level Position Viewer Box[/b]" (Defaulted to On) - Allows you to disable the red wireframe showing where a level belongs in the world.[/p][/*][*][p]In addition to being able to cycle through your selected colour with Q + E, you can now scroll [b]through the palette by holding shift and scrolling[/b] the mouse wheel.[/p][p][/p][/*][/list][h2] [b][u]Bug Fixes and Misc[/u][/b] [/h2][list][*][p]Fixed a bug where you couldn't color in if you zoomed out very far.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed issues with the voxel counts in several Underwater levels. We have also implemented additional validation steps when doing builds to make sure these values are verified before making it to a live branch. This should fix any occurrences of achieving over 100% completion in a level.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue on two arcade levels where users would have one layer that wouldn't have cubes pop in correctly. In the backend, we have implemented additional data integrity checks to avoid this specific issue occurring in future worlds.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a typo in the level name for Boxing Machine.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a UI display glitch that rendered some specific numbers in the colour palette over 100 across two lines.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed all occurrences of some special materials looking awful in the colour palette. This affected materials such as water and bigger voxels (like for flowers).[/p][/*][*][p]Updated credits page to include new Patreons. Beautiful and kind people.[/p][/*][*][p]Achievement descriptions have been changed to read "level" instead of "image".[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where changing worlds on the main menu really fast would break the main menu.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a pretty major memory leak.[/p][/*][*][p]Added achievements support to the Steam store page.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed the visibility (eye) button on the main menu that was found next to completed levels. This button now correctly toggles the visibility of completed levels on the main menu.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug where the display settings weren't saving correctly. This included VSync, FPS, display mode and resolution.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where you could scroll up and down the height of the world in the main menu when you have pages such as the settings and credits open.[/p][/*][*][p]When the "Toggle Click to Color" setting is enabled, it no longer deactivates when you hover over UI. We are still accepting feedback on this feature. If people would like a setting to make it so it doesn't deactivate when completing a color, let us know.[/p][/*][*][p]When you complete a colour with the "Toggle Click to Color" setting enabled, the mouse click input is now consumed. This prevents an issue where you could click on the last voxel of a colour in a layer (disabling the toggle), then, by releasing the click, would enable it again.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][/p][h1]Competition Reminder![/h1][p]Reminder, or update for those of you who missed the news, that we have a Voxel Art competition running right now, where you can create and submit your very own voxel art for the chance of it being added to the game in a free update![/p][p]Even if you haven't made voxel art before, if you've played Minecraft, LEGO, or any other block building game, you can do it! Check out full details on the competition and how to submit here: [dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/3634590/view/501706891564417240"][/dynamiclink][/p]

notes.title: Play Coloring Voxels Now!
notes.notes:
[h1]It's Here![/h1][p]After years of Coloring Pixels, and many months of development, the long-awaited, highly requested sequel is finally here![/p][p]Get your hands on Coloring Voxels right now for free and start coloring your way through seven uniquely themed worlds, each made up of sixteen levels.[/p][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3634590?utm_source=nextfestannounce2"][/dynamiclink][/p][p]We know you'll enjoy playing Coloring Voxels as much as we've all enjoyed making it! Jump in and color from the ground up; you'll be creating pieces with all their innards and intricate details, and watch as they all fit together seamlessly in the final diorama. [/p][p][/p][h1]But Wait, There's More![/h1][p]Seven worlds is a fantastic amount of coloring for you all to enjoy, but we know you'll be looking for more when you're done! That's why we are committed to twelve months of DLC worlds over the next twelve months![/p][p][/p][p]The first DLC is "Computer" (as chosen by our amazing Patreons) and will be a scaled-up PC for you to colour and build, from all the intricate electronics and wiring to the flashy RGB lighting! This will be released in just two weeks on the [b]28th of August, [/b]so make sure you make a note on your calendars.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45637097/9aafbf11cb38ddd04b11b2a8436ae9e441bc8f4f.png"][/img][/p][p]Following DLC will be released on the third Friday of every month, so there's always more content to look forward to! (With the exception of December, where the release date will likely change for the holiday season)[/p][p][/p][p]As well as DLC Worlds, make sure you check out the soundtrack here too! Available right now, the soundtrack includes all 50 relaxing, soothing music tracks from the game, a purchase to support the devs whilst getting access to the game music to play anytime and anywhere![/p][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3774920/Coloring_Voxels_Soundtrack/"][/dynamiclink][/p][h2]Competition[/h2][p]And that's not even everything! We are hosting a Voxel art competition [i]right now,[/i] where you can enter your very own Voxel art for the chance to get your level in the game as a free update for everyone to play![/p][p][/p][p]Even if you've never considered making voxel art before, we encourage all of you to give it a try as it is as simple as playing with Lego or even Minecraft! With a deadline of the [b]10th of October[/b] you have plenty of time to create the perfect piece to submit![/p][p]Full details on the competition can be found here: [dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/3634590/view/501706891564417240"][/dynamiclink][/p][h1]A Message From the Devs[/h1][p]Even though it's been a rough year for the Games Industry, and our little Games Studio felt the impact too, we want to take a moment to say a huge thank you to all of you, from those who have played our Coloring Games from the beginning, to those of you who have only just discovered Coloring Voxels right now. [/p][p]We wouldn't be able to develop games, something we all love doing here at ToastieLabs, without you and your love for our games.[/p][p][/p][p]We've had a great time developing Coloring Voxels, from the early days of envisioning and collaborating on concept ideas, to some long nights of programming and mornings of making Voxel art. Every step along the way has been a learning process for all three of us and an enormous amount of fun. Your overwhelming support and excitement for the game (We've hit our goal of 10,000 wishlists as of writing this, so thank you!) has just been the icing on top.[/p][p][/p][p]Thank you once again! We hope you enjoy the game just as much as we have enjoyed developing it. 💝[/p][p][/p][h1]Your Opinion Matters![/h1][p]This game is brand new today, and we know there are still some features we want to add to Coloring Voxels post-launch. We are looking to add most, if not all, of the settings you are familiar with in Coloring Pixels. Here are some of those features we are committed to adding, but there is always room for more![/p][p]Features and other changes:[/p][list][*][p]Toggle button to hide levels on the main menu[/p][/*][*][p]Achievements are currently capped at 100 (due to Steam limitations), once this cap is removed, we'll be uploading the remaining achievements, majority of which are for the Underwater world[/p][/*][*][p]Font Choices[/p][/*][*][p]Dark mode[/p][/*][*][p]More ways to play, not sure what yet but we know vertical mode and challenge modes have been asked for.[/p][/*][*][p]Seasonal Effects[/p][/*][*][p]Contrast settings[/p][/*][*][p]Performance improvements[/p][/*][*][p]Better Localisation. If you spot any issues with our game localisation, then suggest an edit in our Discord and we will get it changed.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]If there is something not on this list that you would love to see in the game, please let us know by getting in touch here on Steam, on Discord, or just about any way you know how to get in touch with us, as we're very open to all of your feedback and suggestions to make the game a better experience for everyone![/p][p][/p][h2]DLC[/h2][p]Just like Coloring Pixels, we are leaving the DLC World themes up to you! Let us know about any theme ideas you'd like to see in Coloring Voxels and we'll compile them all into a list over on our Discord Server where any member of the server can vote on the ideas they like. [/p][p]Every month, the top 5 voted suggestions will be sent to our Patreon for our Patreon supporters to vote on.[/p][p]This means your idea could very well be the next one in the game![/p][p][/p][h2]Game Review[/h2][p]Last, but certainly not least, we'd be amiss not to ask you to leave a game review on Steam! It may feel cheeky to ask, but your recommendations on Steam are what make or break a game, so if you enjoy Coloring Voxels, make sure you let people know by leaving a positive review![/p][p][/p][p]That's enough chatter! Download Coloring Voxels now and get creative!

You are all amazing![/p][p]With love, the ToastieLabs team <3[/p][p][/p]

notes.title: A New Game Trailer!
notes.notes: [h1]The Release Trailer is Here![/h1][p]That's right! We finally got around to making a brand new game trailer to show off the game in full! The previous trailer, which is still available for viewing on the store page or our YouTube channel, showcases the game in its early development stage. A great deal of work has gone into the game since then, and we wanted to show off![/p][p][/p][p]Check out the trailer on the store page, or on YouTube, and let us know what you think. The end of the video is even localised into various languages on the store page![/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://youtu.be/XZnVOzPoShU"][/dynamiclink][/p][p][/p][p]Don't forget to add Coloring Voxels to your wishlist in the run-up to release on Friday![/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3634590/Coloring_Voxels/"][/dynamiclink][/p]

notes.title: One Week Until Launch!
notes.notes: [h1]One Week To Go![/h1][p]In just 7 days' time, Coloring Voxels will be fully released for everyone to play, including you! [/p][p]A raw mixture of last-minute pressure and overwhelming excitement is the feel in the studio this week as we work to put in the finishing touches to Coloring Voxels.[/p][p][/p][p]Make sure you have added the game to your Steam Wishlist and told your friends about it too, as this is the most impactful time for you to be able to support our game up to release. 💖[/p][p][/p][h1]A Week of Activities[/h1][p]As we count down the final days to the launch of Coloring Voxels, we are hosting a variety of activities and other fun things in our [url="https://discord.gg/toastielabs-750363631279014079"]Discord[/url] - join now and get involved with some friendly competition, from jigsaws to a massive pub quiz, there's plenty to keep you busy while we wait for the game to come out![/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45637097/4e9566f7667aa795b3cdb5abf848428aebcd155e.png"][/img][/p][p]Starting tomorrow on the 9th, and running every day up to launch, we are creating and sharing a variety of activities, and if you have a 3D printer, you can even print some of the levels from Coloring Voxels from Monday! Isn't that nerdy and cool? 🤓[/p][p][/p][p]All of the livestreams you see above will be streamed right here on Steam at 1 pm BST. Make sure you stop by the store page at this time and say hello to us as we play Coloring Voxels and stress Rob out with any last-minute problems we can discover![/p][p][/p][h1]Thank You[/h1][p]We want to take a moment here to express a heartfelt thank you, from all of us here at ToastieLabs to you. This game, and our game studio as a whole, wouldn't exist without the real love and support you show, not just Coloring Pixels, but all of our games. 💓[/p][p][/p][p]So, as a thank you for your support of Coloring Pixels, we are excited for you to get your hands on Coloring Voxels and hope it lives up to your Coloring desires![/p][p][/p][h1]Don't Forget![/h1][p]You can continue to follow along with our development here on Steam, in [url="https://discord.gg/toastielabs-750363631279014079"]Discord[/url] and with our [url="https://www.youtube.com/@toastielabs"]Weekly Dev Vlogs[/url]. We're always available for a chat, even when we're busy.[/p][p][/p][p]We have a brand new trailer coming out sometime next week, so keep an eye out for that, and do not forget to check out the [url="https://www.toastielabs.co.uk/post/coloring-voxels-voxel-art-competition"]Coloring Voxels Art Competition[/url], where you can get your own art in the game too![/p][p][/p][p]Until then, please remember to add Coloring Voxels to your Steam Wishlist if you haven't already; this is still the best way to support our game until release. Thank you! 💖[/p][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3634590?utm_source=nextfestannounce2"][/dynamiclink]With love, the ToastieLabs team <3[/p][p][/p]

notes.title: Voxel Art Competition
notes.notes:
[p][/p][h1]Details[/h1][p]We are launching a Coloring Pixels sequel! To celebrate, we are hosting a voxel art competition to give you, our incredible community, the opportunity to have your own levels in the game![/p][p]That's right, [b]the winners of this competition will feature as levels in Coloring Voxels![/b][/p][p][/p][p]The 16 winners of this competition will be combined into an exhibition world, which will be added in a free update to Coloring Voxels. It's very easy to enter; keep reading to find out all the information you need. When you're ready, click on the big [u][url="https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSe4tOOuwyyZdzuLXvKkQm8GnwswT1WLEFfaOHjUI64imI2dFw/viewform?usp=sharing&ouid=110486707112866030672"]SUBMIT HERE[/url][/u] link at the bottom.[/p][p][/p][p][b]"I canne do it, Captain!"[/b] Yes, you can! It doesn't matter if you've never made Voxel art before; it's super easy to get started and create a whole variety of pieces. The only limitation is your imagination... and I guess the time constraint we're giving you with this competition. [/p][p]Make sure you check out the Suggestions below if you're a first-time Voxeler, and even join our [u][url="https://discord.gg/wwXVWvA"]Discord[/url][/u] to chat with our artist and community for guidance![/p][p][/p][p][b]The deadline is the 10th of October 2025[/b] at 17:00 UTC. The winners will be announced on the 24th of October 2025 via a blog post here on our website, Steam announcement, [u][url="https://discord.gg/wwXVWvA"]Discord[/url][/u], and [u][url="https://twitter.com/ToastieLabs"]X[/url][/u]. Links to the socials can be found at the top right of this website![/p][p][/p][h1]Rules and Suggestions[/h1][p]We will need to modify any submitted work to make things work well in the game, but we have a couple of points to stick to that would help us out. To help improve your chances, we have come up with a few simple rules for you to follow and some suggestions to help you get started.[/p][p][/p][h2]Rules (the dull bit):[/h2][list][*][p][b]You must submit a file in one of the commonly used project files.[/b] Project files are best for us to inspect, and they are easiest to use to modify and import into our Coloring Voxels editor. We will try to accept as many types as we can, but recommend .qb ([u][url="https://www.minddesk.com/"]Qubicle[/url][/u]), .vox ([u][url="https://ephtracy.github.io/"]Magica[/url][/u]) or .gox ([u][url="https://goxel.xyz/"]Goxel[/url][/u]). Sadly, if we can't open the files in any of our editors, they won't be considered. Files such as .fbx, Minecraft files, .gif or image slice files won't work, for example.[/p][/*][*][p][b]The level must be a reasonable size. [/b]This is a difficult rule to quantify. We recommend keeping your levels approximately 50x50x50 in size. You can make things bigger or smaller than that in some dimensions, but just make sure that things don't get too large. For example, the Skeleton level we have provided below is taller than 50 cubes, but has made sure to keep the width and depth dimensions smaller than 50.[/p][/*][*][p][b]You must own the art piece. [/b]Please don't submit on behalf of someone else without their permission. Please make the art piece yourself for this competition. We check to see if the art you submitted belongs to someone else, as we cannot use people's work without their consent.[/p][/*][*][p][b]No Politics, no copyright infringement, keep it family-friendly. [/b]This should go without saying, but we can't accept anything that is politically charged, anything that features clear use of intellectual property, or any dark or sexual themes. We are a small indie company that just wants to keep things chill and can't really deal with lawsuits or complex age ratings.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h2]Suggestions[/h2][list][*][p]Don't think you can't give this competition a go just because you haven't made anything with Voxels before. We all learnt how to make voxel art just for this game, and if you've ever played something like Minecraft before, then you technically already have experience too![/p][/*][*][p]Don't forget about your model's innards! If you have played Coloring Voxels, you know that you place each and every block in the model. That means that it's not all down to the outside view of the model that counts. If you look at the examples below, they show good examples of how the inside of the model can feature some fun and interesting details that aren't immediately visible.[/p][/*][*][p][i]"Which software should I use?"[/i] - It is personal preference, but we recommend using either [u][url="https://goxel.xyz/"]Goxel[/url][/u] (free) or [u][url="https://ephtracy.github.io/"]MagicaVoxel[/url][/u] (also free). We also use [u][url="https://www.minddesk.com/"]Qubicle[/url][/u] here in the office, but it is quite old now and a paid-for product. We will accept any project files from any of these big three editors.[/p][/*][*][p]You can try using your Minecraft files as a base for your art, as Goxel (and probably other Voxel editors) have the ability to import Minecraft files into the editor. Try this out as a starting point and send us your end result, exported in the right format, of course![/p][/*][*][p][i]"I've gone brain dead... I need inspiration!"  - [/i]We can't choose for you, but you can make anything. If you can't think of anything new or inspiring, try making something you love (film, game, pet fish, lasagne) or even just pretend you are playing Minecraft and make a dream home or castle.[/p][/*][*][p]Can I submit multiple times? Yes, don't hold back! Submit as many entries as you like. We will judge each image anonymously and individually. You can win multiple times, but we will cap it so you can't win every slot.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h1]Examples[/h1][p]We realise that making voxel art, while a lot more rewarding and fun, can feel a bit more complicated. That's why each of us at ToastieLabs has made some quick examples for you to look at to see what kind of thing we are looking for.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45637097/e23527264fc2f0f14360fb8beac4eae89bdcc121.png"][/img][/p][p]If we have never made Voxel art before making Coloring Voxels, and can make these, you can too![/p][p][/p][p]Download them here for a closer look:[/p][p][url="https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/13Xtv7QVn1EwWSytlbwFkVauHjoBURoC_?usp=drive_link"]https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/13Xtv7QVn1EwWSytlbwFkVauHjoBURoC_?usp=drive_link[/url][/p][p]
Bonus points if you can guess which was made by our Artist Jack, Designer Lee or Programmer Rob.[/p][p][/p][h2][b][u][url="https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSe4tOOuwyyZdzuLXvKkQm8GnwswT1WLEFfaOHjUI64imI2dFw/viewform?usp=sharing&ouid=110486707112866030672"]Submit Here[/url][/u][/b][/h2]

notes.title: Launch Schedule, DLC Pricing and More!
notes.notes: [h1]Launch Timeline![/h1][p]There's just over 2 weeks until the launch of Coloring Voxels! Make sure you have the 15th of August marked on your calendars and count down the days with us until the release of the best Coloring game this decade![/p][p]As a part of the countdown, we will be hosting activities and competitions in our [url="https://discord.gg/toastielabs-750363631279014079"]Community Discord[/url] for the entire week up to release, so make sure you join our Discord to get involved.[/p][p][i]*A full breakdown of activities will be announced on the 8th of August[/i][/p][p][/p][h1]Monthly DLC![/h1][p]As you are likely aware, the game is releasing with a total of 7 unique worlds, each made up of 16 different levels! This will provide you with an estimated 20 hours of free gameplay, and that's not including New Game+! [/p][p]But what happens when you've played every level and are looking for more? Well, don't worry! Just like Coloring Pixels and our other titles hexceed and WooLoop, we plan to release a new DLC every month! As part of our commitment to the game, we can also confirm today that we will do so for at least the next 12 months![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45637097/9aafbf11cb38ddd04b11b2a8436ae9e441bc8f4f.png"][/img]Starting in August, we will release a new, themed DLC every 3rd Friday of the month. That's on top of the monthly Coloring Pixels DLC, which we schedule for the second Friday of each month. As always, there are a couple of exceptions:[/p][list][*][p]August 2025's additional content to launch on Friday, the 29th, since it is the launch month for Voxels.[/p][/*][*][p]December's world is likely to shift due to the holiday season.[/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45637097/3c64916dde93f9797b5033ae4bced2430c98559d.png"][/img][i]= DLC Release Day[/i][/p][p][/p][h2]Pricing[/h2][p]Each DLC will be priced at [b]$1.99/£1.69 (or your regional equivalent)[/b]. [/p][p]This has been a tough decision for us. We would prefer to offer the DLC at the lowest price Steam allows, like we have previously prided ourselves on. That being said, we are satisfied with this pricing choice as it helps cover the additional costs we have been facing over the past couple of years. Despite being a small indie team, we are subject to things changing that are out of our control, such as the rise in inflation making everything more expensive. We are also aware of the additional development time these DLC worlds require in comparison to our previous titles. Hopefully, this price point will support us for many years to come.[/p][p][/p][p]This is the first time in seven years of DLC that we have raised our prices. It is very important to us that our games are accessible to everyone, and keeping the game free-to-play and DLC prices affordable is one of the ways we can achieve this. We want people to be able to sell a couple of Steam trading cards and choose their favourite themed DLC out of a selection to play if needed.[/p][p][/p][p]We are also happy to confirm today that we will be hosting monthly giveaways in our Discord for each DLC release. Just like we do with Coloring Pixels and WooLoop, we give away 5 keys to winners selected randomly by a Discord bot in our server! It is free to enter, so another reason for you to join the community and chat with like-minded players![/p][p][/p][h2]The DLC Theme Selection Process...[/h2][p][i]"But what themes will we be seeing in Coloring Voxel DLCs?"[/i][/p][p]That's a great question, imaginary person, and one we don't know either! [/p][p][/p][p]We'll probably make Halloween and Christmas-themed worlds in October and December, respectively, as we love these themes in both Coloring Pixels and WooLoop, so we will likely continue that tradition here. Other than that, the DLC themes are entirely up to you, the community. [/p][p][/p][p]We will be using the same established method we use for Coloring Pixels and WooLoop for you to suggest, vote on, and ultimately choose what DLC we will make.[/p][olist][*][p]Suggest an idea, either here on Steam, via Email, on our Discord or any other way you can contact us.[/p][/*][*][p]All the suggestions get listed on our Discord for you to react to/vote on.[/p][/*][*][p]Every month, the [b]top 5[/b] voted suggestions get sent to our Patreons for them to make the final vote on which of the 5 we will be making next.[/p][/*][/olist][p]The first of the Polls is [url="https://www.patreon.com/posts/first-coloring-134770414"]live now on our Patreon[/url] and ends in 3 days! (03/08/2025) Get involved! Some of the best DLC we have made in our last 7 years as a company have been suggested by and voted on by the community.[/p][p][/p][h1]More?[/h1][p]And that's (almost) it for now! You can continue to follow along with our development here on Steam, in [url="https://discord.gg/toastielabs-750363631279014079"]Discord[/url] and with our [url="https://www.youtube.com/@toastielabs"]Weekly Dev Vlogs[/url]. [/p][p][/p][p]In the meantime, look out for news on the upcoming activities, a brand new game trailer and a Coloring Voxels competition where you can get your own voxel art in the game![/p][p][/p][p]Until then, please remember to add Coloring Voxels to your Steam Wishlist; this is the best way to support our game until release. Thank you! 💖[/p][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3634590?utm_source=nextfestannounce2"][/dynamiclink]With love, the ToastieLabs team <3[/p][p][/p]

notes.title: Thank You Steam Next Fest!
notes.notes: [h1]Steam Next Fest[/h1][p]A huge thank you to everyone who stopped by during the Steam Next Fest! We had a great time here at ToastieLabs with our live broadcasts on Steam and with the ongoing chats with you over in our [url="https://discord.gg/toastielabs-750363631279014079"]Discord[/url] server.[/p][p][i](If you missed any of the livestreams and would like to catch up on what you missed, you can find all of the recordings on our [url="https://youtube.com/toastielabs"]YouTube[/url] channel to watch at your convenience.)[/i][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45637097/7244e91f0240491395d67072e0a4d8306b10386d.png"][/img][/p][p]Over 2000 of you played the game demo, which absolutely blows us away! Thank you all so much for your interest and interaction with Coloring Voxels. We are just as excited as you are to see the development progress from now until release in only a couple of months![/p][p]The Demo consisted of a single world (Volcano), which is made up of 16 levels. The overall feedback on the world design was your enjoyment of the art aesthetic, and we couldn't be happier with your kind words. 💖[/p][h1]Some Stats[/h1][p]Once again, your interest and interaction with Coloring Voxels are better than we could ever ask for. Here is a cool, detailed breakdown of the players and wishlists from the Next Fest week. [/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45637097/a1b9e7f9f428b25733fc799e962a84b364ff08f3.png"][/img][/p][p]Over 10% of the players who tested the game demo added it to their wishlists, which is a great conversion rate, especially considering that over 5,000+ of you already had Coloring Voxels on your wishlists before the demo was live.[/p][p]This boost in wishlists has taken us ever closer to our ambitious 7,000-10,000 wishlists goal. Thank you again, and make sure to follow along with the development from here to launch in August to stay up-to-date with the game![/p][p]You can even see the boost Next Fest had on the overall wishlists graph![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45637097/232ff96593c64bd78a267550f548674410fbbd68.png"][/img][/p][h1]What's Next?[/h1][p]It's all hands on deck to get the game ready for the August launch date. The first thing we're working on is a robust game editor so we can all get involved with a more streamlined and efficient method of importing, testing and fixing the game levels. [/p][p]Once this is in place, we have more worlds and levels to make, QA and get ready for release, and there are a lot of features and fixes for our programmer, Rob, to implement. [/p][h1]Your Feedback[/h1][p]A huge thank you to all of you who submitted reports and gave feedback on your experience. We have been taking it all on board and are using it to prioritise what we are implementing into the game.[/p][p]In addition to adding the already promised features, such as graphics settings and improved performance. We have digested all of the feedback to create a prioritised list of tasks to work through. From a couple of bug reports to features and settings you would like to see, we will do our best to get as much in for launch as possible.[/p][p][b]Your Feedback Additions:[/b][/p][list][*][p]Mouse sensitivity settings.[/p][/*][*][p]Keyboard controls.[/p][/*][*][p]Options to change coloring numbers' meaning/sequencing.[/p][/*][*][p]Toggle to turn off the level timelapse when opening a level.[/p][/*][*][p]Main Menu world view improvements.[/p][list][*][p]Hide outside levels so you can see levels in the centre.[/p][/*][*][p]Better methods to view worlds.[/p][/*][*][p]New Game Plus effects.[/p][/*][*][p]Ability to hide your best time from completed levels.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Free camera or something similar at the end of the level.[/p][/*][*][p]Level percentage pop-up[/p][/*][*][p]Level timer pop-up[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Known Bugs/Issues:[/b][/p][list][*][p]Poor game performance[/p][/*][*][p]Poor game controls[/p][/*][*][p]End of levels timelapse sometimes does not repeat.[/p][/*][*][p]Initial timelapse fails if any layer is completed in a different order.[/p][/*][*][p]Layer selection overlapping with the play zone.[/p][/*][*][p]No Autosave on game close.[/p][/*][*][p]Can click through voxels with set camera angles.[/p][/*][*][p]Potential AFK issue when the level is completed.[/p][/*][/list][p]This is just some of the more mentioned parts of the list. Please note that these suggestions are on top of our pre-existing commitment to add many of the settings you can already find in Coloring Pixels. We want to ensure that everyone from Coloring Pixels will feel at home in the sequel, even if you have some strange config set up. [/p][p]We are constantly looking for feedback to act upon, so if you have any more suggestions, please let us know! [/p][h1]Game Launch Soon![/h1][p]It's not too long to go for the launch of the game! Coming August 15th, make sure you have Coloring Voxels on your wishlist and share with your friends. Any additional wishlists from now to release will help us immensely, so thank you in advance for being amazing! 💖[/p][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3634590?utm_source=nextfeststeampost"][/dynamiclink]- With love, the ToastieLabs team <3[/p]

notes.title: Welcome Steam Next Fest!
notes.notes: [h1]Steam Next Fest and Coloring Voxels[/h1][p]Happy Steam Next Fest! 🥳 Thank you for checking out Coloring Voxels! The long-awaited sequel to Coloring Pixels where we take color-by-numbers to a whole new dimension![/p][p][/p][p]Color vibrant dioramas in this 3D, voxel-based art game. From the inside out, everything is fully detailed! Build worlds layer-by-layer and find the hidden treasures and secrets buried under or inside the worlds you create![/p][p][/p][h1]Play the Demo Now![/h1][p]For the duration of the festival, Coloring Voxels has a free Demo available for you to play! The Demo  includes the entire first world (Volcano) for you to complete. Try it, have fun, and hopefully you will get a better understanding of what is to come at launch this August![/p][p][/p][p]Enjoy playing the Demo and let us know what you think, join our [url="https://discord.gg/toastielabs-750363631279014079"]Discord[/url], or chat with us live on stream here on the Steam store page this week! All feedback is appreciated, positive, negative or just some ideas you might have; please reach out![/p][p][/p][h1]Developer Broadcasts[/h1][p]We are excited to be streaming live on the Steam store page three times during the Steam Next Fest! Please stop by if you get a chance to chat with us and ask any questions you have. We'd love to answer them for you or just come by to say hi![/p][p][/p][p]Steam Next Fest Developer Broadcast Schedule:[/p][list][*][p]Tuesday - 10:00 (BST)[/p][/*][*][p]Wednesday - 10:00 (BST)[/p][/*][*][p]Friday - 13:00 (BST)[/p][/*][/list][p]We will be streaming for a few hours on each of these days. If you miss the Streams, don't worry, we will upload the VODs to our [url="https://www.youtube.com/toastielabs"]YouTube[/url] channel for you to watch later.[/p][p][/p][h1]Post Demo News![/h1][p]With the conclusion of Next Fest on the 16th of June, the Demo will no longer be available to try, so make sure you don't miss out during the festival![/p][p][/p][p]We will be taking all of your feedback from the demo on board as we finish up the development over the next couple of months. Make sure you check out the Steam forums as well as our website and Discord to stay up-to-date with the development. [/p][p][/p][p]Until then, please remember to add Coloring Voxels to your Steam Wishlist; this is the best way to support our game until release. Thank you! 💖[/p][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3634590?utm_source=nextfestannounce2"][/dynamiclink]With love, the ToastieLabs team <3[/p][p][/p]

notes.title: Coloring Voxels Demo Goes Live on Monday!
notes.notes: [h1]Get Ready to Play![/h1][p]You don't have to wait until August to play Coloring Voxels! Next week, from June 9th to the 16th, Coloring Voxels is taking part in the Steam Next Fest! [/p][p][/p][p]For the duration of the event, Coloring Voxels will have a free Demo available for you to play! The Demo  includes the entire first world (Volcano) for you to complete. Try it, have fun, and hopefully you will get a better understanding of what is to come at launch![/p][p]Enjoy playing the Demo and let us know what you think, join our [url="https://discord.gg/toastielabs-750363631279014079"]Discord[/url], or chat with us live on stream here on the Steam store page this week! All feedback is appreciated, positive, negative or just some ideas you might have; please reach out![/p][p][/p][h1]Developer Broadcasts[/h1][p]We are excited to be streaming live on the Steam store page three times during the Steam Next Fest! Please stop by if you get a chance to chat with us and ask any questions you have. We'd love to answer them for you or just come by to say hi![/p][p][/p][p]Steam Next Fest Developer Broadcast Schedule:[/p][list][*][p]Tuesday - 10:00 (BST)[/p][/*][*][p]Wednesday - 10:00 (BST)[/p][/*][*][p]Friday - 13:00 (BST)[/p][/*][/list][p]We will be streaming for a few hours on each of these days. If you miss the Streams, don't worry, we will upload the VODs to our [url="https://www.youtube.com/toastielabs"]YouTube[/url] channel for you to watch later.[/p][p][/p][h1]Access the Demo for longer![/h1][p]With the conclusion of Next Fest on the 16th of June, the Demo will no longer be available to try, so make sure you don't miss out during the festival![/p][p][/p][p]Suppose you enjoy the demo so much, or do unfortunately miss the demo during the Next Fest; in that case, you can join our [url="https://www.patreon.com/toastielabs"]Patreon[/url], where all backers from the "Toastie Member" tiers and above will have continued access to the demo up to the release of Coloring Voxels in August![/p][p][/p][p]Until then, please remember to add Coloring Voxels to your Steam Wishlist; this is the best way to support our game until release. Thank you! 💖[/p][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3634590?utm_source=nextfestannounce"][/dynamiclink]With love, the ToastieLabs team <3[/p][p][/p]

notes.title: The Coloring Pixels Sequel!
notes.notes:
[h2]Coloring Pixels 2![/h2]
The long-awaited sequel to Coloring Pixels is coming soon!
Taking your favourite coloring game from 2D Pixels to 3D Voxels! Experience color-by-numbers like never before in our evolution of the Coloring genre!


[h2]Coloring Voxels[/h2]
Taking Coloring Pixels to a whole new level in the highly anticipated 3D sequel! Don't just colour the outside of a 3D object; build it yourself, block by block! Build up your creations layer by layer, level by level, to create a whole diorama tens of thousands of voxels big.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33218193/f982614ca36958b6acfa42c261b808537c2187f5.gif[/img] 

Relive the calming and creative atmosphere of Coloring Pixels in our new 3D-based coloring game! From the music and art style to the gameplay and satisfying progression, relax and get creative with every level you build, in a format you already know and love.

Wishlist here to stay up-to-date with development and get involved with Steam Next Fest! 
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3634590?utm_source=announce1_cv


[h3]Patreon Early Access[/h3]
If you can't wait for Next Fest or the full release in August, then check out our Patreon page here, where the top-tier supporters can get access to the Coloring Voxels Demo right now!
